itemList.description: Earth work in surface excavation for stripping, seating of bund, Road way, by manual means for  owering & leveling the ground for all works other than foundation & depth in all kinds of soil not  xceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring,  trutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage & other appurtenances required to complete the work. (Item No1.1, Page No.5,  V1 P.W.D.C S.R. 2023-24)

Providing, laying, spreading and compacting graded stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired density. (Item No4.17, Page No.26,  V3 P.W.D.C S.R. 2023-24)

Providing and laying 60mm thick factory made precast M -30 grade Cement Concrete Paver Block as per IRC SP 63:2018 & IS 15658 for Cycle Tracks & Pedestrian Footpaths of approved hape and colour, laid in required pattern and including over 30mm thick compacted bed of coarse sand, filling the joints with fine sand etc. all complete as per the direction of Engineer-incharge. (WMM/WBM Base to be paid separately if necessary as per relevant technical specification) (Item No 6.8.1, Page No.51,  V3 P.W.D.C S.R. 2023-24)

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes achine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators,including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.Mix 1:2:4 Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates(Item No 2.1.6, Page No.15,  V3 P.W.D.C S.R. 2023-24)
